traps.note: Jonas's 'SOC 2 Type II' claim is contradicted by Amira's check and the rep's update. The corrected fact is Type I done, Type II report Dec 1. The card must not say Relay is Type II certified.
Luis's cost concern is a condition on his support, not an objection. Listing it as an open objection is wrong.
Amira does not oppose Relay. She supports picking it on Nov 12 with go-live gated on the report. Conditional.
Ben has four messages. His support is conditional on the DPA. The final 'ok' (m053) is a backchannel, not additional support.
Prices changed. Relay is $215k with implementation, Hollis $290k. The earlier $180k and $240k are superseded.
All-hands presenter is off-topic and unowned. It belongs under separate issues, not blockers or actions.
Keiko leaned to build, then dropped it. A later card must not show her supporting build.
